flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/cas_integration/service/CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java (per-notice results OCMS-4001 'Invalid Notice Number', OCMS-4003 'Notice Already Paid' on PLUS payment activation). ocmsadminui NoticeSearch: no error message specific to this function.
note: Status 'User Story Removed': the verdict stays Removed even though similar code exists. The story asks for an error message when the search value is invalid (invalid notice number, paid, cancelled) or no applicable notices are found. Similar code only exists in the PLUS API (not in the officer search): OCMS-4001 'Invalid Notice Number' (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:781-782) and OCMS-4003 'Notice Already Paid' (:789-796). There is no cancelled-notice check at that endpoint, and no 'no applicable notices' message in Notice Search (only 'Record is not found' for upload, NoticeSearchUploadContext.tsx:135). Every step that has code is rated Sebagian.

steps.step: An error is shown when the notice number is invalid
steps.detail: Only in the PLUS API: a notice that is not found gets OCMS-4001 'Invalid Notice Number' (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:777-784). It is an API response to PLUS, not a message on the officer's search. Story is Removed, every step with code is rated Sebagian.

steps.step: An error is shown when the notice is already paid
steps.detail: Only in the PLUS API: a non-empty crs_reason_of_suspension gives OCMS-4003 'Notice Already Paid' (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:789-796). Not a message on the officer's search.

steps.step: An error is shown when the notice is cancelled
steps.detail: updatePaymentActivationForNotice (CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:763-838) only checks that the notice exists and crs_reason_of_suspension; there is no cancelled/suspension check in that method or in the search UI.

steps.step: A message is shown when no applicable notices are found
steps.detail: Notice Search has no dedicated 'no applicable notices' message. The only similar message is 'Record is not found' in the upload path (NoticeSearchUploadContext.tsx:135), not part of enable/disable.
